items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: But Ruth Brown one time, she said, oh, this band can't play my stuff... But after they played the thing now, she was hugging everybody and kissing everybody.

ctx.x: No, there's nothing hard about that. I just wanted somebody to be under pressure. Of course, if you're playing a long two or three weeks with somebody, you're gonna get better.

No, it's like the band at the Polytheater. I mean, every week they're playing for people. So they're up on all the latest tunes and everything that comes out. And with the technology that you have today, you hit this button and your band sound like a big orchestration there. That's what it sound like. With these things they have on pianos now, organs now, man, you sound like anything you wanna sound like. Yeah. And if you know the songs, hey, man, it's gonna sound similar to the records, you see. Yeah. Because…
And Slim's, all Slim's people could read? In Lloyd's band. In Lloyd's band, I mean, Lloyd.
